title: Agent Role State
description: Structured checkpoint for agent role state. Written after each deliverable, read at session start for fast resume. Fields are ordered in two blocks: identity/provenance header (for indexing, search, eviction evaluation) followed by state payload (checkpoint data).

role-slug.description: Role identifier. Starts with a letter. Slug-compatible. Canonical source: naming.schema.json.

scope-path.description: Slash-separated slug segments. Canonical source: naming.schema.json.

_comment_header.description: Fields above this point are lightweight metadata used for indexing, search, eviction evaluation, and session grouping. They map directly to indexed columns in role_state table.

role.description: Role slug (matches role-prompt.schema.json slug). First component of the hash chain key.

scope.description: Variable-depth org path for the role. Examples: 'lanytehq' (org-wide), '3leaps/ipcprims' (project-scoped). Second component of the hash chain key.

session_id.description: Stable identifier for the logical session. Generated at lanyte-attest begin (from JWT sid claim) or auto-generated by lanyte-ctx for unattested sessions. Survives JWT expiry and re-attestation within the same session. All checkpoints in a session share this ID. Primary key for session-level queries, eviction grouping, and archive operations. Absent for legacy file-based checkpoints.

authored_by.description: Attribution for the entity writing this checkpoint. Structured for parseability but NOT a verified identity — trust level depends on whether the session is attested (see session_ref). Does not affect the hash chain.

actor_type.description: Category of actor. 'supervised_agent' = model operating under human supervision (Claude Code, Codex). 'human' = person acting directly. 'autonomous_agent' = persistent process with its own identity (future).

supervisor.description: Handle of the human supervisor for supervised_agent sessions. This is the trust anchor — the human who attested or could attest the session.

model.description: Self-reported model name (e.g., 'claude-opus-4-6', 'gpt-5-codex'). Unreliable — models may misidentify. Treat as best-effort metadata.

handle.description: User handle for human actors (e.g., '3leapsdave'). For autonomous agents, their registered identity ref (future).

session_ref.description: Session attestation token (JWT) or its hash. When present, indicates the session was attested by a human supervisor via lanyte-attest. When absent, the checkpoint is unattested — attribution is self-reported only. A session may have multiple JWTs (re-attestation on expiry) but one session_id.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of this checkpoint. Primary sort key for history, eviction, and resume queries.

session_type.description: Session lifecycle state at checkpoint time. 'active' = mid-session checkpoint. 'handoff' = session ending, next session should resume. 'cold_start' = first checkpoint for this role+scope. 'resume' = session that resumed from a prior checkpoint.

_comment_payload.description: Fields below this point are the checkpoint data. Heavier arrays that store the actual working state. In SQLite, stored as the state_json blob.

status_summary.description: One-paragraph summary of current state. The single thing a resuming agent reads first.

id.description: Task ID from the workstream board (e.g., CRT-004, AGI-011)

next_action.description: The specific next thing to do when resuming this task

ref.description: Reference to ADR, brief, or chat thread (e.g., ADR-0010, AGI-011)

decisions.description: Decisions made since last checkpoint. Prevents re-derivation on resume.

blocked_by.description: What this action is waiting on (task ID, person, event)

pending_actions.description: Actions this role is tracking but hasn't completed yet.

completed_this_session.description: Deliverables completed in the current session. Useful for handoff summaries and session-level reporting. Cleared on session boundary.

pushed.description: Whether changes have been pushed to remote

modified_files.description: Repos with uncommitted or unpushed changes at checkpoint time.

blockers.description: Current blockers preventing progress. Empty array = unblocked.

context_refs.description: File paths or URLs a resuming agent should read to rebuild context. Keep this minimal — only files needed for the active task, not the full warm-up sequence.
